channel.title: MintWave Studio Blog
channel.description: Practical guides from the makers of Cable Calc, MultiTimer, Days Until, Daily Budget, Hatch Day, Sire & Dam and Endly.

item.title: What size breaker for a cable? Match the breaker to the cable (IEC 60364)
item.description: Choose a breaker for a cable with Ib ≤ In ≤ Iz (IEC 60364): worked examples for 2.5, 4 and 6 mm² copper, and why a bigger breaker is unsafe.

item.title: How much can I spend per day? Work out a daily budget in 5 steps
item.description: Work out how much you can spend per day: income minus bills and savings, divided by days to payday. Worked example, overspending and big costs.

item.title: Progesterone timing for dog breeding: when to mate after the LH surge
item.description: How progesterone testing finds ovulation: baseline, LH surge and ovulation values in ng/mL and nmol/L, and the best days to breed by semen type.

item.title: Why didn't my eggs hatch? Causes by candling stage and fixes
item.description: Eggs not hatching? Find the cause by candling stage: infertility, early and late deaths, temperature, humidity and turning, with fixes for next time.

item.title: Best before vs use by: what food date labels really mean
item.description: Best before is about quality, use by is about safety. Learn what each food date label means, what is safe after it and how to track expiry dates.

item.title: How to time a whole dinner with several timers at once
item.description: Work backwards from serving time, start the longest job first and run one timer per dish. A simple method for timing a whole dinner so it all lands hot.

item.title: What to track in an endometriosis symptom diary (and what to bring to your appointment)
item.description: What to log in an endometriosis symptom diary (pain, cycle, bleeding, meds, impact) and how to turn it into a clear summary for your doctor.

item.title: Voltage drop: why a cable that carries the current can still be too long
item.description: A cable can carry the current and still be too long. How voltage drop is calculated, the 3 % and 5 % limits, and when to size the cable up.
